overview: 针对人形机器人行走与操作任务，本文提出InterEvolve框架以实现测试时（test-time）的策略进化，无需重新训练即可解决未见过的任务。该方法通过一个物体感知的前向-后向行为基础模型连接规划与控制，并利用大语言模型和数值优化器动态进化奖励程序。实验表明，该方法能有效调动已有技能组合，在复杂任务中表现出优于人工设计奖励的适应性，并已在Unitree G1实机上得到验证。

highlights.text: 提出一种基于大模型和数值优化的奖励程序进化方法，在测试阶段通过重复利用已有技能解决复杂任务。
highlights.evidence: A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants.

highlights.text: InterEvolve能够激发机器人基础模型的潜在运动操作能力，实现多样化任务的自主执行。
highlights.evidence: Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies.

highlights.text: 该框架在仿真环境下的长周期任务及复杂场景中表现出色，并支持Unitree G1机器人的实机自主运行。
highlights.evidence: It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
